title: Software Development Intern
shortDescription: Worked as part of an internal web and desktop app development team in the IT department at Steel Dynamics, Inc.
longDescription: As a Software Development Intern in the IT department at Steel Dynamics, Inc., I worked closely with an internal team focused on building robust web and desktop applications. One of my primary projects involved modernizing a legacy, data-driven PowerBuilder reporting tool for Microsoft Dynamics GP. By transitioning this general ledger tool into a streamlined Vue.js application, I significantly reduced the onboarding time required for new employees. I also integrated a report scheduling interface from a rough PowerShell script into an existing brownfield Vue app for Steel Dynamics' internal daily operations workflow, giving users the ability to enable or disable the generation of specific reports. Additionally, I designed and implemented an automated daily digest service that integrates with our IT ticketing software. This service automatically alerts management to new Data Definition Language (DDL) changes in our MS SQL databases, ultimately saving 6 to 18 hours per quarter that were previously spent manually linking database changes to approval tickets during audits. I also built an internal GitHub analytics tool in Vue.js that queries GitHub's GraphQL API to pull commit history across all of our repositories for a given time frame, visualizing the results as bar charts and heatmaps broken down by time, developer, and repository so management could see whether contributions were evenly distributed across the team.

title: Co-Founder & Lead AI Developer
shortDescription: Co-Founder & Lead AI Developer of a senior capstone LLC developing a proof-of-concept autonomous drone system powered by a proprietary UV light communication module.
longDescription: As Co-Founder and Lead AI Developer, I architect the decentralized software stack, visual navigation systems, and edge AI detection pipelines that enable multi-agent swarm operation without central infrastructure. I engineered a decentralized multi-drone mesh communication layer using ROS 2 and a proprietary UV light communication module to provide low-latency coordination in RF-denied, jammed, and high-interference environments. I integrated OpenVINS and Swarm-SLAM to deliver real-time 3D mapping and pose estimation across multiple autonomous nodes without GPS or centralized ground stations. I integrated and adapted existing multi-agent path-planning and trajectory-optimization libraries within ROS 2 to enable inter-swarm collision avoidance, dynamic trajectory execution, and spatial coordination across moving nodes. I also implemented an end-to-end perception stack that fuses 2D YOLO detections with 3D SLAM geometry to identify, classify, and geographically plot targets on a shared spatial grid.

title: Software Engineer Intern

longDescription: As a Software Engineer Intern at Rose-Hulman Ventures, I was responsible for developing and maintaining web applications using React and Node.js. My role involved creating internal documentation to facilitate knowledge sharing among team members and participating in code reviews to ensure code quality and adherence to best practices. I collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions that met client requirements.

title: Teaching Assistant
shortDescription: Assisted students in laboratory for Introduction to Systems Programming and graded for a multitude of other courses.
longDescription: In my role as a Teaching Assistant at Rose-Hulman Institute of Technology, I assisted students in the laboratory for an introductory systems programming course. My responsibilities included providing support to students in understanding complex programming concepts, debugging code, and guiding them through practical exercises. Additionally, I graded students' submissions for Introduction to Database Systems, Introduction to Web Development, and Theory of Computation.

title: Volunteer
